en_body:
A complaint about loud DJ music on Diwali night in Kotiya Nayak village, Gola, led to a police case against six accused, according to a Hindustan report published on November 11. The complainant alleged that a request to lower the volume resulted in an assault that injured two people. These remain allegations subject to investigation.
